submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I spread them across the composition line: Mn-rich (idx 3, Mg 0.08), near the MgMn2O4 spinel (idx 16, Mg 0.32) and Mg-rich (idx 24, Mg 0.71). All three gave essentially zero photocurrent. Idx 16 and idx 3 both read -0.0 A, and idx 24 read -1e-8 A. So idx 16 is tied for the highest measured value. I chose it over idx 3 because the spinel phase has some reported photoactivity. The Mg-Mn oxide system appears essentially inactive under 3.22 eV illumination.

rejected.reason: Measured -1e-8 A, slightly below the other two
Measured -0.0 A, tied with idx 16; the Mn-rich MnOx phases are poor photoanodes
